svg.title: Digital forensic acquisition ordering, artifact timeline analysis, and chain of custody
svg.desc: Three panels. The first covers acquisition: live RAM capture with WinPmem or LiME, bit-stream raw or E01 disk imaging behind a write-blocker, and the rule that volatile data is captured before the host is shut down. The second lists artifact sources by platform — Windows registry hives, event logs, Prefetch, Shimcache, Amcache and the USN journal; Linux journald, auth.log, shell history, auditd and cron; cloud CloudTrail, VPC flow logs, GCP audit logs and Azure activity logs — and separates evidence of execution from evidence of existence. The third covers chain of custody: hash the image on acquisition, log the acquirer, time and location, and analyze only working copies.
svg.text: Digital Forensics & Evidence Handling
Acquisition ordering, artifact timeline analysis, and the integrity record that makes both defensible.
ACQUISITION ORDER (RFC 3227, BCP 55)
Most volatile first
• Memory: WinPmem / LiME before shutdown — keys, injected code
• Disk: bit-stream .dd or .E01 image taken behind a write-blocker
• Cloud: volume snapshot plus audit log export, isolated account
• Live capture is not read-only — the tool runs on the host it reads
ARTIFACT TIMELINE ANALYSIS
Execution evidence vs existence evidence
• Ran: Prefetch, Sysmon Event ID 1, Security Event ID 4688
• Existed only: Shimcache, Amcache — not proof of execution
• Windows: registry hives, .evtx logs, USN journal
• Linux / cloud: journald, auditd; CloudTrail, VPC flow logs
CHAIN OF CUSTODY & EVIDENTIARY INTEGRITY
Integrity from acquisition onward, plus provenance
• Hash on acquisition with SHA-256 or stronger. NIST SP 800-86 (2006) predates the SHA-2 transition and names MD5 / SHA-1.
• Log custody continuously: evidence ID, acquiring investigator, date and time with UTC offset, every transfer, storage location.
• Analyze working copies only. Custody and hashing support admissibility; they do not guarantee it — the rules of evidence decide.
CAPTURE VOLATILE FIRST → IMAGE DISK BEHIND A WRITE-BLOCKER → BUILD THE TIMELINE → PROVE INTEGRITY AND PROVENANCE
